The plan is accepted for schema preparation only; numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow and are not generated here.",

      "cal_days": 30,

      "rolling_step_days": 30

  "workflow": [
